The '''AH-77 Twenchok combat submersible''' was one of the many vehicles designed by the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] at their main research and development facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]], during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
